title: OxygenOS 12 C16
body:
I Updated my OnePlus 8T to OxygenOS 12 C16, and since the Update, the OB1 Collector goes always in Deep Sleep mode, and it's not possible to change something in the Settings.
The App is allowed to be executed in Background, and all Permissions are granted.

The WakeUp Time is very long, Around 5minutes...
Is there a solution which I don't know?

![Screenshot_2022-05-08-16-18-57-84_2dd2c1bcb8f659cd696bcba2072f751b](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/91971937/167300565-1a91d91c-5d1e-4dd3-bb85-b47ee69a52cb.jpg)
